 Suryakumar’s blazing 82 powers Mumbai to emphatic win over Gujarat
 By: Agencies 
 Date:
 November 17, 2026 
 Share post:
 WhatsApp Facebook X ReddIt Telegram Linkedin 
 GROUP D 
 Kolkata, Nov 16: Suryakumar Yadav continued his explosive form with another match-winning knock, smashing 82 off just 29 balls as Mumbai chased down Gujarat’s 198-run target in only 15.4 overs in their Group D match of the Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy here on Monday.
The T20 World Cup-winning captain, who struck 60 off 21 balls against Hyderabad in Mumbai’s tournament opener, once again dominated the opposition attack with seven sixes and nine fours. Sarfaraz Khan provided valuable support with an unbeaten 40 off 17 deliveries to complete a comfortable victory.
Earlier, Gujarat posted 197, thanks largely to late contributions from Ashutosh Sharma, who scored 42 off 22 balls, and Vishal Jayswal (38 off 21). Mumbai’s Shardul Thakur and Atharva Ankolekar claimed three wickets each.
In another Group D encounter, Uttarakhand defeated Goa by five wickets after successfully chasing a target of 169 in 18.1 overs.Goa were bowled out for 168 in 19.4 overs, with opener Abhinav Tejrana top-scoring with a 36-ball 76. However, Aarav Mahajan’s unbeaten 60 off 38 balls and Tejasvi Jaiswal’s 46 from just 20 deliveries guided Uttarakhand home.Meanwhile, Vidarbha registered their second consecutive victory, defeating Odisha by eight wickets at the Jadavpur University Ground.Nachiket Bute claimed four wickets to restrict Odisha to 161 for eight, despite Gourav Choudhary’s 53 off 28 balls. (PTI)
